source.rightsEvidence: The pinned source template contains its original CC BY 3.0 license text and attribution README in rights/. The adapted local screenshots and generated imagery are separately recorded there.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The page opens with a full-screen split chapter: editorial copy on one side, a generous domestic photograph on the other, and a slim identity/navigation rail above. Three alternating spotlight sections create long-form story rhythm. A short service ledger follows, then a horizontally browsable strip of generated everyday-life images, plain-language FAQs, and a warm contact close. Mobile stacks photographs before their copy, keeps service rows full width, and turns the photo gallery into a touch-swipable rail. Generated people are illustrative and must not represent real provider staff or customers. This contract transfers layout and pacing only, not the fictional copy, brand, or images.

heroGeometry.alignment: left text and right photographic field
heroGeometry.viewport: headline, supporting copy, and care-conversation CTA visible in initial desktop viewport

navigationGeometry.mode: slim brand rail with inline text links
navigationGeometry.placement: over the top edge of the opening
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact inline links without a full-screen overlay

typography.body: clear sans-serif with restrained line length
typography.scale: large headline, small uppercase chapter labels, moderate body

palette.contrastIntent: warm but clearly readable, with white-on-dark only in the FAQ chapter

imageTreatment.mode: alternating full-bleed domestic photos and swipeable image rail
imageTreatment.crop: wide chapter crops on desktop and stacked portrait-friendly crops on mobile
imageTreatment.focalPoint: keep people and everyday activity legible without over-staging

servicePresentation.pattern: editorial ruled index with a number, service name, one-line scope, and arrow
servicePresentation.interaction: full-width touch row linking to a relevant next step

ctaPlacement.secondary: after individual story chapters and at contact close

motion.primitive: viewport-triggered image fade and touch-scroll gallery
motion.library: native CSS, IntersectionObserver, and horizontal overflow scrolling
motion.reducedMotion: static fully visible chapters and no smooth-scroll dependency

rules: retain horizontal gallery as swipe rail

prohibitedPatterns: pill nav repeated across every reference
invented care credentials or clinical claims
unverified rates, service area, or staff
stock people presented as real customers

requiredSignatureElements.description: full-screen split copy/photo opening with early conversation CTA
ruled service ledger rather than cards

acceptanceChecks: At 1440 by 900, the opening split layout shows the service promise and CTA without clipping.
Alternating image chapters lead into a ruled, concise service index and a horizontal image rail.
At 390 by 844, each split chapter becomes image-first and the page width stays within the viewport.
FAQs and contact appear as real page sections with keyboard-accessible controls and visible form status.
No generated person is represented as a real caregiver or customer, and no service claims are stated as verified facts.

review.notes: Verified desktop and mobile full-page captures, section sequence, generated image loading, FAQ contrast after local override, and no page-level horizontal overflow. The horizontal gallery is intentionally swipeable.
